description: This file defines the ModelScreen class, which models screen components in the OFBiz widget framework. It includes constructors for parsing XML, methods for rendering screens, and transaction management logic.

classes.name: ModelScreen
classes.description: Represents a screen model in OFBiz, capable of rendering and managing transactions, based on given XML configuration.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to process this widget.

methods.name: getTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured transaction timeout value.

methods.name: getModelScreenMap
methods.description: Returns the map of screen models.

methods.name: getUseTransaction
methods.description: Indicates whether to use transactions during rendering.

methods.name: getSection
methods.description: Returns the top-level section of the screen.

methods.name: getSourceLocation
methods.description: Returns the source location of the screen XML file.

methods.name: renderScreenString
methods.description: Renders the screen using the provided renderer and context, managing transactions as configured.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves the LocalDispatcher from the context.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the Delegator from the context.

methods.name: resolveTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Resolves the transaction timeout value from parameters, attributes, or defaults.
